data.title: MySQL 8 cold-cache and auth-switch support
data.description: Review bn-2m5m: bounded AuthSwitchRequest handling, caching_sha2_password RSA-OAEP full auth using explicit host entropy, secret zeroization and typed errors, MySQL 8.0.29 live acceptance, and mysql 0.2.1-rc.1 packaging. Gates: just check, sigil-check, live-acceptance, reproducible.

data.body: [P1] The protected publisher cannot publish this prerelease. This line changes the package to 0.2.1-rc.1, but .github/workflows/publish-release.yml:96 still accepts only X.Y.Z and lines 181-183 require isPrerelease=false. Therefore the separately authorized candidate cannot be released through the immutable, attested workflow described by this repository. Accept canonical SemVer here too and derive/verify GitHub prerelease state from the version, while preserving the existing exact digest/commit gates.

[P2] The retained acceptance artifact records the obsolete e9659bb SQL-0.2 candidate even though this harness now gates cc4dab15 and the reviewed tip is 26e2b1f. The current successful run therefore emits false source/candidate provenance in identities.txt. Emit the exact commit this harness verifies (preferably a single constant used by both the ancestry check and evidence) so the acceptance record is self-consistent.
